A (database, container, object, field) not listed here is expected to produce no finding.
negative_control: the location looks sensitive (name or shape) but holds no sensitive data.
name_contains_value: the object, container or key names embed values (ADR-0009, security review M2). name_values must never reach the console (invariant I2 test, P2-E).
expected_normalized_name: name expected on the uplink after normalization (ADR-0009).
values: every distinct seeded value of the location; none may appear in clear text in the console database (P2-E).
MySQL / MariaDB: Discovery excludes the system schemas mysql, information_schema, performance_schema and sys (docs/05-security.md).

never_sampled: a credential (CAS client secret, Authorization header) the connector never samples, masks nor fingerprints; expects no classifier, and its values must never reach the console, the agent logs or the spool (ADR-0041 decision 14).
cas: locations as connector-cas reports them (ADR-0041 decision 4); the registry is dev/cas/services, the audit log dev/.state/logs/cas/cas_audit.log.
